//: scripts/ was covered by no tsconfig — client's includes only src, server's only src and shared. So capture-snapshot.ts, find-league.ts and the seed helpers were never typechecked; they failed at run time or not at all. This config exists to give them one, and to give eslint's projectService a project to attach them to. module/moduleResolution describe tsx, which loads these as ESM: NodeNext would infer CommonJS from the root package.json and reject the import.meta every one of them uses.
